integrity: The exact Fourier-Bessel coefficient and uniform all-index limit are proved analytically. Finite numerical cross-checks confirm selected identities but do not replace infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the planar unit circle and its Gaussian second-moment radial observation; asymptotic angular-degree law as the Gaussian scale tends to infinity. No all-parameter mode staircase, no higher-dimensional result, and no independent mathematical validation. Historical priority cannot be guaranteed.
title: Gaussian second-moment Fourier extension: migrating angular extremizers and sharp spectral stability
